text:
Predicates:
AppropriateForAllAges(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
ChildrenCanWatch(x) ::: children can watch x without guidance from parents.
ContainsExcessiveContent(x) ::: x contains excessive erotic and violent content.
ChildrenCannotWatchWithoutParents(x) ::: children cannot watch x without guidance from their parents.
RatedGeneralAudience(x) ::: x is rated General Audience.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: x is a family-friendly animated film.
InSeries(x, y) ::: x is a film in series y.
Film(x) ::: x is a film.

Premises:
∀x (AppropriateForAllAges(x) → ChildrenCanWatch(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for all ages, children can watch it without guidance.
∀x (ContainsExcessiveContent(x) → ChildrenCannotWatchWithoutParents(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive content, children cannot watch it without guidance.
∀x (RatedGeneralAudience(x) → AppropriateForAllAges(x)) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, it is appropriate for all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) → RatedGeneralAudience(x)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
∀x (InSeries(x, 'Frozen') → FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x)) ::: All 'Frozen' series films are family-friendly animated films.
Film(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a film.
AppropriateForAllAges(hachi) ∨ InSeries(hachi, 'Frozen') ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for all ages.

Conclusion:
(ContainsExcessiveContent(hachi) ∧ InSeries(hachi, 'Frozen')) ∨ (¬ContainsExcessiveContent(hachi) ∧ ¬InSeries(hachi, 'Frozen')) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' either contains excessive content and is in 'Frozen', or neither contains excessive content nor is it in 'Frozen'.
